factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report (page 32) states: 'In June 2025, AAC Clyde Space carried out a directed share issue of 585,938 shares at SEK 110 per share, raising approximately SEK 64.5 M before transaction costs... In December 2025, AAC Clyde Space AB raised approximately SEK 50.3 M before transaction costs [through the first tranche of the directed share issue to Bonnier Capital].'

factual_claims.claim: Reflecting these equity infusions, the group equity ratio improved to 80 percent from 71 percent at the end of 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report (page 32) states: 'As of 31 December 2025, the equity to assets ratio was 80% (71).'

factual_claims.claim: The order backlog at year-end was reported at SEK 352 million, compared with SEK 641 million at the close of 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report (page 32) states: 'Order backlog decreased to SEK 352 M (641 M).'

factual_claims.claim: Subsequent to the reporting period, the company secured a major order valued at EUR 76.3 million from OHB Sweden for the EPS-Sterna weather constellation, significantly expanding its order backlog and establishing a stable foundation for future growth as the company continues to scale its vertically integrated space data and satellite manufacturing operations.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Significant events after the end of the year (page 32) states: 'AAC Clyde Space has received an order from OHB Sweden valued at EUR 76.3 M (approx. SEK 820 M) for the delivery of 20 microwave radiometers for the EPS-Sterna satellite programme.'

numerical_claims.claim: Net sales for the group decreased by 16 percent to SEK 295.3 million, compared with SEK 352.9 million in the previous year.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income (page 33) shows net sales of SEK 295,283k (2025) and SEK 352,857k (2024). The 16% decrease is mathematically accurate: (352,857 - 295,283)/352,857 = 16.2%.

numerical_claims.claim: EBITDA amounted to SEK 17.5 million... lower than the SEK 46.7 million reported in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income (page 33) shows EBITDA of SEK 17,463k (2025) and SEK 46,694k (2024). The values match when rounded to one decimal place (17.5M vs 46.7M).

numerical_claims.claim: Data and services segment net sales increasing to SEK 80.1 million from SEK 44.9 million.

numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 5 Segment Information (page 45) shows Data & Services net sales of SEK 80,142k (2025) and SEK 44,887k (2024). The values match when rounded to one decimal place (80.1M vs 44.9M).

numerical_claims.claim: EBITDA for products and missions decreased to SEK 16.8 million from SEK 51.6 million.
